title: What Endures; the Word Through the Senses; the Buds Sweet and Bitter
description: What lasts, how truth becomes audible, why the same ground bears fruit of two kinds. T91 — why the illumining principles within do not yet rejoice wholly: they cast no shadow and have no ignorance, yet they grieve because they see the self enthroned and the Living Soul drawn taut between above and below; they shall rejoice only when the soul is refined and the enemy bound at the end. T92 — how interior truth takes outward form: the word brought forth from within passes through the five articulating degrees (palate, tongue, teeth, lips, breath) before it is heard outside, like a coin minted by five artisans before it can pass between hands. T93 — why the same natural mind brings forth fruit sweet in one place and bitter in another: the Lord's ordering nourishes in one part of the soul, while the self's energy floods the same elements with its shadow in another; remedy is in recognition.
